attempts.summary: Configured sudo command logging on node1: sudo now logs via syslog facility local2 (via /etc/sudoers.d/syslog-local2), and rsyslog (/etc/rsyslog.d/sudo-commands.conf) routes local2.* to /var/log/sudo-commands.log then discards it (~), keeping entries out of /var/log/messages. Verified logging works and stays isolated from the general log both before and after a full node restart (boot_id changed from 16724682... to 8a973a0c...), confirming persistence.
